postconditions.description: The function must return a string.

postconditions.expression: all(char in a + b for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each character in the result must be present in the concatenation of `a` and `b`.

postconditions.expression: not any(char in return_value and char in a + b for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: No character in the result should be present in both `a` and `b`.
